sources.attribution_rule: Record author, fiscal year and publication date separately. A Greg Abel letter is not a Buffett statement.
Use reports for company facts; do not attribute all report text or company action to Buffett.
Separate Buffett-signed statements from Berkshire corporate announcements and Abel-era actions. A missing current-year page is a visible degraded check, never proof that no new material exists.
Use for filing, date, governance and transaction facts; a filing does not itself prove Buffett's view.
Use complete meetings and identify each speaker; clips are locators, not independent evidence.
